#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="inventory database"
description="Inventory database readiness service"
command="/usr/local/bin/inventory-database"
command_background=true
pidfile="/run/inventory-database.pid"

depend() {
	need localmount
	before inventory-api
}

start_pre() {
	rm -f /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready
}

start_post() {
	ready_tries=0
	ebegin "Waiting for inventory database readiness"
	while [ ! -e /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready ]; do
		if [ ! -s "$pidfile" ] || ! kill -0 "$(cat "$pidfile")" 2>/dev/null; then
			eend 1
			eerror "inventory database exited before becoming ready"
			return 1
		fi
		ready_tries=$((ready_tries + 1))
		if [ "$ready_tries" -ge 100 ]; then
			eend 1
			eerror "timed out waiting for inventory database readiness"
			return 1
		fi
		sleep 0.1
	done
	eend 0
}

stop_post() {
	rm -f /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready
}

#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="inventory database"
description="Inventory database readiness service"
command="/usr/local/bin/inventory-database"
command_background=true
pidfile="/run/inventory-database.pid"
retry="TERM/2/KILL/2"

depend() {
	need localmount
	before inventory-api
}

start_pre() {
	rm -f /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready
}

start_post() {
	ready_tries=0
	ebegin "Waiting for inventory database readiness"
	while [ ! -e /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready ]; do
		if [ ! -s "$pidfile" ] || ! kill -0 "$(cat "$pidfile")" 2>/dev/null; then
			eend 1
			eerror "inventory database exited before becoming ready"
			return 1
		fi
		ready_tries=$((ready_tries + 1))
		if [ "$ready_tries" -ge 100 ]; then
			eend 1
			eerror "timed out waiting for inventory database readiness"
			return 1
		fi
		sleep 0.1
	done
	eend 0
}

stop_post() {
	rm -f /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready
}

	while :; do

			eend 1

			return 1
		fi
		sleep 0.1
	done
}
